summary: Hongli Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of an unregistered sale of equity securities. The company issued 1,300,000 ordinary shares at $0.25 per share to a U.S. investor for gross proceeds of $325,000, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and/or Regulation D. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No board recommendation, deal structure, or strategic implications beyond financing are noted. No risk-arb angle exists.
